description: Add, revise, verify, or remove one routing identity on a contact. Use this for emails, phone numbers, social handles, and URLs — anything that could locate a person. Do not use manage_attribute for these.

inputSchema.description: Add, revise, verify, or remove one routing identity on a contact.

contact.description: Target contact. Required when action=add. Provide contactId or identity.

ifExists.description: Return an existing identity on this contact without changes.

type.description: Identity type: did, atproto_did, email, phone, url, website, handle, x, twitter, linkedin, github, mastodon, bluesky, telegram, whatsapp, signal, matrix, discord, slack, instagram, facebook, youtube, tiktok, address, other, account_id, alias, or custom:<name> (lowercase a-z, 0-9, underscore or hyphen).

identityId.description: Identity id. Required when action=revise, verify, or remove.

input.description: New identity payload. Required when action=add.

ifExists.description: Return an existing identity on this contact without changes.

now.description: Optional timestamp. Accepts epoch milliseconds integer, ISO 8601 date-time with Z/offset, YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, today, tomorrow, yesterday, +3d or -2d. UTC midnight for dates; dueAt uses UTC end of day.

type.description: Identity type: did, atproto_did, email, phone, url, website, handle, x, twitter, linkedin, github, mastodon, bluesky, telegram, whatsapp, signal, matrix, discord, slack, instagram, facebook, youtube, tiktok, address, other, account_id, alias, or custom:<name> (lowercase a-z, 0-9, underscore or hyphen).

Optional identity type: did, atproto_did, email, phone, url, website, handle, x, twitter, linkedin, github, mastodon, bluesky, telegram, whatsapp, signal, matrix, discord, slack, instagram, facebook, youtube, tiktok, address, other, account_id, alias, or custom:<name> (lowercase a-z, 0-9, underscore or hyphen).

removedAt.description: Removal timestamp. Optional for action=remove. Accepts epoch milliseconds integer, ISO 8601 date-time with Z/offset, YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, today, tomorrow, yesterday, +3d or -2d. UTC midnight for dates; dueAt uses UTC end of day.

verifiedAt.description: Verification timestamp. Optional for action=verify. Accepts epoch milliseconds integer, ISO 8601 date-time with Z/offset, YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, today, tomorrow, yesterday, +3d or -2d. UTC midnight for dates; dueAt uses UTC end of day.
